title: OwnFrame shared definitions
description: Building blocks shared by vendor.schema.json and syndicate.schema.json. Not a data file schema on its own — validators load it alongside the others (ajv-cli: -r schema/common.schema.json).

id.description: Stable kebab-case id; equals the file name without .json and doubles as wiki page slug.

uniqueName.description: Catalog uniqueName (locale-stable); names, images and translations come from the catalog.

itemName.description: English catalog name, written while filling in instead of a uniqueName. `node scripts/check-references.mjs --resolve` replaces it with the uniqueName when the name is unambiguous.

hub.description: Place in the game world. The apps translate hub names; use "other" plus a detail text when none fits.

currency.description: credits, platinum, standing (of the owning syndicate), ducats, or the uniqueName of the resource, token or item handed over.

itemName.description: Stand-in for currency while filling in: the English name of the resource or item handed over.

verified.description: When the entry was last checked in game — shown as "as of" on the wiki page.

gameVersion.description: Game update the check was made on, e.g. "Update 44".
